author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have built the world’s first quantum battery that uses entangled molecules to charge faster as its size increases. This prototype stores energy in excited electron states and can theoretically scale up to charge devices like electric cars significantly faster than traditional batteries.

Source Article: https://www.nature.com/articles/s42255-026-01485-0#Sec49
